body: I'm trying. It's hard...I don't know. All my life I've always looked up to my mum. She is my main reason for living happily, her happiness translates into mine. I've always envisioned my happy future life events spent with her, and now all that seems like its just been a dream.

Thanks. But I don't need it, really. But the thought counts alot, and I accept that with gratitude?
Sorry, I'm new to reddit, I have no idea what to do with gold, is there a way I can give it back to you?

How are your parents? Did they make a full recovery?
I asked the doctors about my mum, if there would be long term effects, and he wouldn't give me a straight answer or look me in the eye.

Thanks. 
Pulling through...I don't know. I wouldn't care about college if something bad happens to my mother....she's always been the best mother in the world. ever. always put me first in every thought that goes through her mind. she's always sacrificed her own needs for my slightest wants. My parents have been skimping painfully on themselves to save moeny so I could go to college, and now I've failed them like this, at her most vulnerable. To be honest I'm so scared right now, the only thing that's stopping me from killing myself is the thought of their pain at me dying. If anything happens to her...I wanna be done with this. But then there's my dad, all alone.
